stories.story_fr: Coca-Cola HBC signe un bon debut d'annee avec une croissance organique du volume de +9,6% au T1 2026 (environ +3,5% hors effet annee bissextile) et des gains de parts continus, illustrant la resilience de son portefeuille de boissons.
stories.story_en: Coca-Cola HBC delivered a strong start to the year with +9.6% organic volume growth in Q1 2026 (c.3.5% excluding the leap-year benefit) and ongoing share gains, showing the resilience of its beverage portfolio.
stories.quote: Good start to the year with 11.6% organic revenue growth ... Organic volume grew 9.6%, or c.3.5% excluding the benefit

stories.story_fr: La dynamique des categories cles se confirme au T1 2026 : les volumes de Sparkling progressent de +9,4% et l'Energy poursuit sa croissance, deux moteurs a forte marge du portefeuille.
stories.story_en: Momentum in key categories continued in Q1 2026: Sparkling volumes grew +9.4% and Energy kept growing, two high-margin engines of the portfolio.
stories.quote: Sparkling volumes grew 9.4% and Energy grew

stories.story_fr: Le Coffee enregistre une forte croissance dans le canal hors-domicile au T1 2026, confirmant la pertinence de la strategie multi-categories de Coca-Cola HBC au-dela des boissons gazeuses.
stories.story_en: Coffee posted strong growth in the out-of-home channel in Q1 2026, confirming the relevance of Coca-Cola HBC's multi-category strategy beyond sparkling drinks.
stories.quote: Strong growth of Coffee in the out-of-home channel

stories.story_fr: La croissance est large et equilibree au T1 2026, avec une hausse du revenu organique dans tous les segments : Etablis +7,3%, En developpement +10,3% et Emergents +15,0% portes par de forts volumes.
stories.story_en: Growth was broad-based and balanced in Q1 2026, with organic revenue up across all segments: Established +7.3%, Developing +10.3% and Emerging +15.0% led by strong volumes.
stories.quote: Organic volume and revenue growth across all segments ... Established: Organic revenue increased by 7.3% ... Developing: Organic revenue up 10.3% ... Emerging: Organic revenue up 15.0%, led by strong volumes

stories.story_fr: Coca-Cola HBC consolide sa position de leader sur le Sparkling avec une nouvelle annee consecutive de gains de parts de valeur sur la plupart de ses marches, soutenue par cinq piliers de croissance et un fort levier de penetration.
stories.story_en: Coca-Cola HBC is consolidating its Sparkling leadership with another consecutive year of value share gains across most of its markets, supported by five growth pillars and strong penetration upside.
stories.quote: We have a leading position in Sparkling and strong positions in other categories, with opportunities to continue to expand market share ... We are gaining share in Sparkling in most markets ... consecutive year of share gains
